# learn

The toolkit around models, scikit-learn style: the estimator protocol, preprocessing (scalers, encoders, imputers), composition (pipelines, column transformers), model selection (cross-validation, searches), calibration, conformal prediction, active learning and privacy. Explanation lives in `explain`, fairness in `fairness`.

- function `conformal.ts` (file): Conformal prediction: split, cross and adaptive prediction sets. `src/lib/learn/conformal.ts:1` `mdml-engine/learn`
- function `drift.ts` (file): Concept-drift detectors: DDM, EDDM, ADWIN, KSWIN. `src/lib/learn/drift.ts:1` `mdml-engine/learn`
- function `feature-selection-wrappers.ts` (file): RFE, sequential selection and stability selection around any estimator. `src/lib/learn/feature-selection-wrappers.ts:1` `mdml-engine/learn`

## learn/bases

The bases methods are built on (`docs/methods_port/bases.md`): one per way of running, each owning the loop, the standard events, serialisation, the record plumbing and the kind's standard probes, so that a particular method is a few declarations. Here the iterative base (a library algorithm run as a session behind scikit-learn's `fit`), the trainer base (minibatch training of a network over `fitAlgorithm`, with parameter checkpoints for probes at any step), the agent base (an agent learning in an environment over `trainingAlgorithm`), the sweep and repeated-fit base (a study that runs an inner method over a grid or sample of its knobs, with repeats, and the race of variants in lockstep) and the estimator kinds as add-ons; the procedure base follows.

- structure `agent.ts` (file): Agent base: an RL agent learning in an environment, as a session. `src/lib/learn/bases/agent.ts:1` `mdml-engine/learn`
- structure `iterative.ts` (file): Iterative base: an estimator whose fit is an Algorithm run live. `src/lib/learn/bases/iterative.ts:1` `mdml-engine/learn`
- structure `sweep.ts` (file): Sweep and race: run an inner method over a grid of knobs. `src/lib/learn/bases/sweep.ts:1` `mdml-engine/learn`
- structure `trainer.ts` (file): Trainer base: minibatch training of an nn module as a session. `src/lib/learn/bases/trainer.ts:1` `mdml-engine/learn`

- algorithm `sweep`: Run a method over a grid of knobs, one trial per step. `src/lib/learn/bases/sweep.ts:424` `mdml-engine/learn`

## learn/model-selection

Model selection, the `learn.modelSelection` namespace: cross-validation splitters (including blocked, purged and spatial ones for dependent data), cross-validation with learning and validation curves, grid, random and nested hyperparameter searches, and information criteria and bootstrap error estimates.

- function `criteria.ts` (file): AIC, BIC, GCV and other model-selection criteria. `src/lib/learn/model-selection/criteria.ts:1` `mdml-engine/learn/model-selection`

- function `crossValidate`: Cross-validate an estimator with several scorers. `src/lib/learn/model-selection/cross-validation.ts:322` `mdml-engine/learn/model-selection`
- function `kFold`: K-fold splitter; stratified, group and shuffle variants beside it. `src/lib/learn/model-selection/splitters.ts:130` `mdml-engine/learn/model-selection`

## learn/preprocessing

Data preprocessing, the `learn.preprocessing` namespace, scikit-learn and imbalanced-learn style: scalers and power transforms, categorical encoders, feature expansions and binning, missing-value imputation and resampling for imbalanced classes, all following the estimator protocol so they compose in pipelines.

- estimator `oneHotEncoder`: One-hot encode categorical columns. `src/lib/learn/preprocessing/encoders.ts:174` `mdml-engine/learn/preprocessing`
- estimator `simpleImputer`: Fill missing values by mean, median or most frequent. `src/lib/learn/preprocessing/imputation.ts:185` `mdml-engine/learn/preprocessing`
- estimator `standardScaler`: Standardise features to zero mean and unit variance. `src/lib/learn/preprocessing/scalers.ts:85` `mdml-engine/learn/preprocessing`
